nc060c1c624.headline: Clear & Present Danger: Economy facing rising risk of stagflation
nc060c1c624.summary: India’s economy is increasingly at risk of stagflation due to ongoing turbulence from the Covid-19 pandemic and other economic pressures.
nc060c1c624.why: Stagflation—simultaneous inflation and economic stagnation—poses challenges for policymakers and investors, affecting growth prospects and market stability in a major emerging economy.
nc060c1c624.why_moved: Concerns about stagflation in India affect investor sentiment and market outlook due to the country’s significant role in global growth.
